entries.provenance: DLSS NR 310.9.16 runtime (version resource 'NVIDIA DLSSNR - DVS PRODUCTION', CL 39025366) from the RankFTW/rhi-repo release dlssnr-310.9.16, archive digest dbeb1f2790b5c621887db99b1a56ac8bd5cb35207e8c074cbb806710f7460cab verified before extraction. NOT the NVIDIA-signed file: it carries no Authenticode signature, and an appended .nrcubin section holds community-built sm_75/86/89 kernels beside NVIDIA's sm_120 ones - the same kind of modification as 310.8.SF-v2, on NVIDIA's 310.9.16. It carries two networks: A, which renders byte-identical to 310.8.SF-v2, and NVIDIA's lightweight B (NRPreset 2). The player sends it to RTX 50 only (docs/measurements/runtime-310916-20261031).

ShortFuse's community-modified universal DLSS NR 310.8 runtime (string version 310.8.SF.0, numeric 310.8.2.0) from RankFTW/rhi-repo release dlssnr-310.8.SF-v2, GitHub verified archive digest 1da35941894994eb087e017577829e492454e9bae3a6a9397027069ceb74955c. The modification removes the embedded NVIDIA signature and extends the leaked 310.8.0 runtime to Turing, Ampere, Ada and Blackwell; the previous lock was the RTX 40-targeted dlssnr-310.8.0-RTX40 build. Since 0.30 it is the previous runtime: the one RTX 20-40 render with, and on RTX 50 the opt-in that reproduces 0.28. It sits in its own folder under its own name so the add-on is pointed at it by NRRuntimePath and the top-level module check never sees two NR DLLs.

NVIDIA-signed DLSS SR 310.9.16 runtime from the RankFTW/rhi-repo release dlss-310.9.16, fetched by tools/fetch_neural_runtime.ps1 and verified against archive digest 1823ec911c77482e6731447dfb0db3def8aa710e092f59f58c4c4c55285d492d before extraction and against the per-file digest above after staging. Replaces 310.9.1 (file 3975567B...), which replaced 310.8.0 (file C85F971C...). This is the module RenoDX detours to observe the player's DLSS/DLAA create before it builds feature 18; 310.9.16 renders byte-identical to 310.9.1 on every clip measured (docs/measurements/runtime-310916-20261031).

ReShade 6.8.0 with add-on support, proxy DLL taken from ReShade_Setup_6.8.0_Addon.exe, fetched by tools/fetch_neural_runtime.ps1 and verified against installer digest afe4c8f13048306307983b8b3d41d5bf00a86820440b0e57dea10950e1176445 before extraction and against the per-file digest above after staging.

RenoDX DLSS 5 add-on 10.8.0 from the RankFTW/rhi-repo release renodx-dlss5-10.8.0, archive digest faba7814fa90b6b21786c98a45732dbe80f01fa36745c46324472e14ac0f440d verified before extraction. Replaces 6.5.3 (archive 553b1619..., file 342341F6...). 10.8.0 drives both NR runtimes - it reads NRRuntimePath and the network choice NRPreset - and its config is ConfigVersion 10 / ConfigRevision 1, which the player stamps so the add-on never migrates the file; with NRDetailStability and NRSkinIndependent pinned off it renders 310.8.SF-v2 as 6.5.3 did, within 0.1 of an 8-bit level on average and byte-identical on one clip of five (docs/measurements/runtime-310916-20261031).
